From Wiktionary, the free dictionary

Bulgarian

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

доба́вям (dobávjam, “to add”) +‎ -ка (-ka)

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): [doˈbafkɐ]
  • Audio (Standard Bulgarian):(file)
  • Rhymes: -afkɐ
  • Syllabification(key): до‧бав‧ка

Noun

[edit]

доба́вка • (dobávka) f (relational adjective доба́въчен)

  1. additive, supplement, further contribution
    хранителна добавка ― hranitelna dobavka ― nutritional supplement
    правя добавка ― pravja dobavka ― to make an extra contribution
  2. bonus, extra
    в добавка ― v dobavka ― in addition

Declension

[edit]
Declension of доба́вка
singular plural
indefinite доба́вка
dobávka 		доба́вки
dobávki
definite доба́вката
dobávkata 		доба́вките
dobávkite

Related terms

[edit]
  • до́бив (dóbiv, “yield”)
  • доби́тък (dobítǎk, “livestock”)

References

[edit]
  • “добавка”, in Речник на българския език [Dictionary of the Bulgarian Language] (in Bulgarian), Sofia: Bulgarian Academy of Sciences, 2014
  • “добавка”, in Речник на българския език [Dictionary of the Bulgarian Language] (in Bulgarian), Chitanka, 2010

Russian

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

доба́вить (dobávitʹ) +‎ -ка (-ka)

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): [dɐˈbafkə]
  • Audio:(file)

Noun

[edit]

доба́вка • (dobávka) f inan (genitive доба́вки, nominative plural доба́вки, genitive plural доба́вок)

  1. additive (substance altering another substance)
  2. amendment
  3. second helping
  4. refill

Ukrainian

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From доба́вити (dobávyty) +‎ -ка (-ka).

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): [dɔˈbau̯kɐ]
This entry needs an audio pronunciation. If you are a native speaker with a microphone, please record this word. The recorded pronunciation will appear here when it's ready.

Noun

[edit]

доба́вка • (dobávka) f inan (genitive доба́вки, nominative plural доба́вки, genitive plural доба́вок)

  1. additive
  2. additional helping/portion/serving, second helping
  3. supplement
    біологі́чно акти́вна доба́вка
    biolohíčno aktývna dobávka
    dietary supplement
    (literally, “biologically active supplement”)
    вітамі́нна доба́вка
    vitamínna dobávka
    vitamin supplement
